# BBTx Consulting

> BBTx Consulting helps leaders and organizations make better decisions, align their people, and turn strategy into sustained execution — guided directly by Dr. Grant Tate's decades of executive leadership, organizational transformation, and coaching experience. AI is an enabling capability, not the category.

BBTx is a Charlottesville, Virginia-based consulting practice led by Dr. Grant Tate. Work spans strategy and advisory, organizational assessment, leadership and team development, implementation and change support, AI integration, and executive recruitment assessment — delivered directly by Grant, not a junior team.

## Services

- [Strategy & Advisory](https://www.bbtx.ai/services/strategy-advisory): Helping leadership teams create the clarity, alignment, and discipline required to turn priorities into action.
- [Organizational Assessment & Analysis](https://www.bbtx.ai/services/organizational-assessment): Seeing the organization as it actually is, and understanding what to do about it.
- [Leadership & Team Development](https://www.bbtx.ai/services/leadership-development): Building the capability leaders and teams need to navigate complexity, strengthen trust, and improve performance.
- [Implementation & Change Support](https://www.bbtx.ai/services/implementation-support): Moving from planning to implementation through accountability, communication, reinforcement, and execution support.
- [AI Integration & Innovation](https://www.bbtx.ai/services/ai-integration): Integrating AI in ways that improve performance and build organizational capability — addressing the organizational reasons most AI initiatives fail, not just the technical ones.
- [Executive Recruitment Assessment Services](https://www.bbtx.ai/services/executive-recruitment): An independent way for search committees to evaluate executive finalists against the actual requirements of the position.
- [All Services](https://www.bbtx.ai/services): Overview of BBTx's full engagement model.

## Programs

- [1:1 Executive Coaching](https://www.bbtx.ai/coaching): Individual coaching and a live group cohort with Grant Tate, built around real decisions rather than a generic curriculum.
- [Courses](https://www.bbtx.ai/courses): The Making Modern Managers program plus focused AI courses for leaders, consultants, and coaches.
- [Strategic Digital Twin Snapshot](https://www.bbtx.ai/digital-twin-snapshot): A free, surface-level first look at an organization's public positioning, visible strengths, and possible blind spots.
